mjswan embed test: four simulations
===================================

Preview only. Four mjswan Cloud simulations on one page, as many as the Manipulation
page will carry. No lazy loading: on iPad it keeps the player from appearing, and each
embed only shows its cover until Play is pressed.

LEAP Hand
---------

.. raw:: html

   <iframe src="https://embed.mjswan.com/L3eRFxI" title="LEAP Hand (mjswan)"
     allow="xr-spatial-tracking; fullscreen"
     style="width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; border: 0; border-radius: 6px;"></iframe>
